stem.en: What happens if members cancel a class less than two hours before it starts?

options.en: They cannot book for a week

why.en: "Please cancel at least two hours before, or you'll have to pay a two-pound fee."

why.ru: Отменяйте минимум за два часа, иначе «you'll have to pay a two-pound fee».
